Section header FLOATING SOLIDS, VISIBLE FOAM AND/OR OILS
Adjacent sampling-location language on the same page specifying collection after treatment and prior to the receiving stream

grounding.selected_observations[1].excerpt:
FLOATING SOLIDS, VISIBLE FOAM AND/OR OILS

There shall be no discharge of floating solids or visible foam in other than trace amounts.
Samples taken in compliance with the monitoring requirements specified above shall be taken at the discharge after the treatment system and prior to the receiving stream.

grounding.known_missing_information: Packet is auto-assembled from the nominated passage; it may be evidence-insufficient.

payload.rationale: The evidence packet confirms the nominated limitation sentence, its section header, and adjacent sampling-location language on page 5, but it does not define or operationalize 'trace amounts' for floating solids or visible foam. No numeric threshold, narrative compliance criterion, or referenced test method appears in the selected observations. The obligation's demanded judgment—what constitutes trace amounts for compliance determination—therefore cannot be established from the packet. ACCEPT would improperly close an undefinitional term without establishing evidence of its meaning; REJECT would require positive evidence that a particular interpretation is excluded, which is likewise absent. UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
